product.title: Key West Dolphin Watch and Snorkel Tour - Eco Adventure

description.text: Get ready for fun in the sun—and check off two top experiences in just one trip—on this dolphin-watching and snorkeling tour off the coast of Key West. Departing Key West, look out for dolphins swimming alongside the boat, then jump in for a shallow-water snorkel at the Key West National Wildlife Refuge with many different species of marine life. Relax, feel the warm sea breezes, and select from a variety of refreshing beverages on board the boat.Admire views of the scenery that many Key West visitors don't get Go dolphin-watching and snorkeling on this two-in-one boat tour Complimentary beer, Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
